## Basin boundary validation

The basin polygon classifies 12 of 12 reference places with certain membership correctly (in: Vientiane, Luang Prabang, Phnom Penh, Jinghong, Khon Kaen; out: Bangkok, Kunming, Hanoi, Mandalay, Guangzhou, Chiang Mai, Ho Chi Minh City).

## Occurrence data

- Harvested (georeferenced, no geospatial issue): 153,800 records; published: 153,798; excluded as grade D: 2.
- Inside the basin: 16,143; outside: 137,655.
- Generalised coordinates: 3,788 records of 15 sensitive species.
- Records without an event date: 5,453 (left blank, never invented).
- Taxa with published records: 311; with records inside the basin: see occurrence layer summary.
